name: inspect_packet_capture
description: Inspect caller-selected fields in an existing local packet capture with TShark 4.x. Return 50 matching frames by default, with match_offset/match_limit paging and coverage counts; match_limit:null requests all remaining matches. Preserve repeated values, frame numbers, display filter, decode-as rules and pass mode in inline Evidence with source/tool identity and diagnostics. Optional packet_limit counts input packets before filtering; output paging does not shorten dissection or two-pass reassembly. Requires Linux, util-linux prlimit, and TShark 4.x on PATH or through absolute REA_TSHARK_COMMAND. File-only analysis; no live capture or device communication. Missing fields or no matches do not establish absence of device traffic.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

decode_as.description: Explicit TShark decode-as selections, e.g. tcp.port==8888,http

display_filter.description: Optional Wireshark display filter (-Y), applied within the read limit

fields.description: TShark field names to return, e.g. ip.addr, usb.endpoint_address, btatt.opcode; frame.number is always included

match_limit.description: Return at most this many matching packets after filtering; default 50. Null explicitly returns all remaining matches within producer resource limits.

match_offset.description: Skip this many matching packets after filtering

packet_limit.description: Maximum input packets to read before filtering; omitted scans to EOF within resource limits

two_pass.description: Use two-pass analysis for fields requiring later packets; false requests a single pass
